gen-fs-bespoke-slab-archivo: Dignified, a bit bookish: Bespoke Slab holds its midline high, and Archivo below it opens its curves outward. The serif is best at declaring; the sans is best at explaining.
gen-fs-bespoke-slab-fs-asap: Dignified, bookish, and set with a high midline: Bespoke Slab. Its best work is big and brief, while Asap, with open-arc c forms and capitals nearly matched by its body height, carries the quieter text beneath.
gen-fs-bespoke-slab-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Bespoke Slab brings a bookish, dignified serif with its midline set high up the letters. And Be Vietnam Pro is the draw, with bent-steel strokes whose curve endings never crowd each other.
gen-fs-bespoke-slab-fs-epilogue: A high-set midline gives Bespoke Slab its bookish, dignified look. And where the serif lends dignity, Epilogue, with wire-like monoline strokes and stubby ascender tips, adds loose, contemporary ease.
gen-fs-bespoke-slab-fs-fira-sans: A high-set midline marks Bespoke Slab as bookish and dignified. Fira Sans, with constant pressure and a generous x-height, would carry paragraphs smoothly, its s curves open wide at both ends.
gen-fs-bespoke-slab-fs-merriweather-sans: A midline set high gives Bespoke Slab its bookish, dignified manner on the page. And Merriweather Sans, with sturdy-looking tall letters and an e that opens clearly rightward, grounds the page.
gen-fs-bespoke-slab-fs-ranade: Bookish is the first word for Bespoke Slab, whose midline sits high and gives it dignity. And Ranade, of slightly shifting weight and wide spacing, does well at a generous size.
gen-fs-bespoke-slab-fs-supreme: Crisp, heavy-looking text with open letters sits under Bespoke Slab, whose midline rides high and bookish. Supreme is best given a touch more size, which lets that weighty strip breathe.
gen-fs-bespoke-slab-general-sans: Dignified, that's the first word for Bespoke Slab's high midline. The serif is best at entrances, while General Sans, with a steady pen line, is best at carrying text.
gen-fs-bespoke-slab-manrope: Manrope reads bright, with every curve left open at the mouth. Bespoke Slab brings bookish dignity with a high midline, and the real draw is that marker-like constant line sitting beneath it.
